name: Protocol rows set the rules, then log a tap
looks: Under a headline about setting rules up front, a short stack of labelled rows types in, each with a small icon, a variable and its value (a dose, a metric, a target). A beat later a single daily check-in line appears with a rounded button that fills solid and relabels itself "Taken" the instant it's tapped.
build: Rows fade/slide in top to bottom, 120-150ms apart, icon first then label then value. The check-in button's fill sweeps from outline to solid colour on tap (`200ms, power2.out`) while its label cross-fades to the confirmed word.
sound: A light tick per row landing, a satisfying soft thud on the button's fill-and-confirm.
prompt: List a short protocol as labelled rows typing in top to bottom, each pairing an icon with a variable and its value, then show a single daily check-in action where a button fills solid and relabels itself confirmed the instant it's tapped, so the whole beat reads as rigour followed by one simple daily habit.
